scope: current PSP source adapter against a fresh isolated upstream release
psp_commit_note: Source includes the 3.10.0 permanent-error classification change and the invalid SS-2022 server-key classification fix; policy/docs-only changes follow this tested source commit.

ci_image_execution_method: The manual Test workflow runs the pinned linux/amd64 image before merge; no local container runtime was used.
checker: deploy/compat/check-go-results.mjs --profile third-party-3xui-live with the canonical profile extended to require the two supplementary tests and both AES subtests

supplementary.method: temporary in-package Go overlay using the production adapter; the weekly-renewal fixture is set through the panel API, not an inconsistent database-only edit
checks: SS-2022 aes-128-gcm and aes-256-gcm inbound add/update and client add/disable/enable/delete; quota, expiry and connection limits preserved; Xray remains running

negative subSortIndex=-3 preserved and config-only inbound update preserves independent inbound enable and client UUID/enable/quota/expiry/device cap
PSP UpdateClient clears panel-side resetWeekday=3 in both clients and client_traffics after the fixture is applied through the panel API

source_review.method: git diff v3.9.0..v3.10.0 and v3.10.0..v3.10.2 with the official tagged source
findings: PSP API routes, client and server controllers, Client model fields, xray.ClientTraffic, the client service and traffic writer are unchanged from 3.10.0

normalizeSubSortIndex still maps zero to 1 and preserves explicit negative values
3.10.0 introduced save-time SS-2022 and salamander validators; the existing review classifies chacha20 rejection and the new fix also classifies invalid server keys as permanent

limits: Two fail2ban probes are N/A; not counted as coverage. Nine canonical required adapter tests plus two supplementary tests passed.
Windows release locally executed; pinned Linux container is validated by CI rather than a local container runtime.
No historical PSP binary verification or existing-database upgrade verification.
No full proxy dataplane, live-connection continuity, multi-node production topology or full PSP traffic/reconcile-chain verification.
3X-UI native MASQUE, XDRIVE, TUIC, MTProto and AmneziaWG features are outside this PSP adapter certification.
